annotated-notes-threaded.reason: Text notes with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for them (note icons); PDF.js draws nothing

annotated-redact.reason: Two unapplied Redact annotations with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for them (red outlines); PDF.js draws nothing

annotated-shapes.reason: Annotations with no /AP, each reader generating its own: the engine closes the polygon, draws the ink as smooth curves and boxes the FreeText; PDF.js leaves the polygon open, draws the ink as straight segments and the FreeText unboxed

freetext-fonts.reason: FreeText annotations with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for each with a border; PDF.js draws the text alone

annotated-unsupported.reason: A Link and a FileAttachment with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for them (a blue link border, a pushpin icon); PDF.js draws nothing

form-bare-appearances.reason: A text field with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for it (a bordered box); PDF.js draws nothing

saved-replied.reason: A reply note written as another program would, with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for it (a speech-bubble icon); PDF.js draws nothing

redact-annotations.reason: A Text note with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for it (a speech-bubble icon); PDF.js draws nothing

redact-foreign-mark.reason: An unapplied Redact annotation with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for it (a red outline); PDF.js draws nothing

redact-text-clip.reason: SECRET-ALPHA in render mode 7 (clip) under a magenta fill: the engine shows the magenta text through the clip, PDF.js draws nothing there

corpus-shade.reason: Mesh shadings (rows four to eight, first two columns): the engine blends through olive and brown where PDF.js blends magenta to cyan; function-based, axial and radial shadings agree

corpus-shade-tensor.reason: Coons and tensor patch meshes: in four clipped squares the engine draws different patch outlines (petals and stars) from PDF.js (diamonds and wedges)

corpus-alpha-composite.reason: Screen and Normal blends at partial alpha: PDF.js draws the cyan square and its overlap; the engine draws only the two pink squares

corpus-matte.reason: Images with a /Matte soft mask: colours differ, most in the top band of the first images (PDF.js pink, the engine brownish); the readers un-premultiply the matte differently

corpus-jpxdecode.reason: JPEG 2000: PDF.js leaves two of the four images blank (one shows only a black square) and draws the SMaskInData overlay darker; the engine draws all four

corpus-bug-1396264.reason: JPEG 2000 image: PDF.js draws narrow vertical colour stripes, the engine two flat bands (red over blue); cause not yet investigated

corpus-bug-1746.reason: Type 3 glyphs over a CCITT image at half opacity: the engine draws both glyphs much paler than PDF.js (opacity applied differently); cause not yet investigated

corpus-bug-1883.reason: A NoRotate (/F 16) annotation on the pages with /Rotate 90 and 180: the engine keeps its arrow upright, PDF.js turns it with the page

corpus-bug-1388.reason: Text in render mode 2 (fill and stroke): the engine draws the glyph, a black square; PDF.js draws nothing

corpus-annots.reason: A combo box widget with no /AP: the engine generates an appearance for it (a drop-down arrow); PDF.js draws nothing

corpus-bug-1302355.reason: PDF.js draws the SoftLight-blended form (a black rectangle); the engine draws a blank page

corpus-smask-blend.reason: PDF.js draws the form under the alpha soft mask and Screen blend (a grey and a black square); the engine draws a blank page
